newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Oil Refineries profit up 56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Oil Refineries profit up 56 pct.

text.p: Mauritius Oil Refineries reported on Monday a 56 percent jump in pre-tax profit to 27.25 million rupees ($1.32 million) for the financial year ending on June 30.
The pre-tax profit was up from 17.4 million rupees in the previous financial year.

Mauritius Oil Refineries' turnover for the 1995/96 financial year was 27 percent higher to 423.5 million rupees from 332.3 million rupees and profit after tax climbed to 24.4 million rupees from 14.9 million rupees.
The price of Mauritius Oil Refineries shares surged on the Mauritius bourse during Monday's session up 50 cents to 8.80 rupees but no shares were traded.
